tags.name: Clinical vs. Public Health Approach
tags.description: Clinical approach (health of individuals) vs. public health approach (health of populations).

tags.name: History of Epidemiology
tags.description: History and development of epidemiology and the people behind it.

tags.name: Roles of Epidemiology
tags.description: Roles of epidemiology in public health and the steps in solving health problems (definition, descriptive vs. analytic epidemiology, core functions).

tags.name: Natural History & Spectrum of Disease
tags.description: Natural history and spectrum of disease; infectious (bacterial, viral, fungal, protist, prion) and noninfectious causes (accidents, exposures, toxicities).

tags.name: Epidemiology Terminology
tags.description: Basic terms from the glossary of CDC's Principles of Epidemiology in Public Health Practice (outbreak, epidemic, pandemic, risk, vector, etc.).

tags.name: Surveillance
tags.description: Role of surveillance, the 5-step surveillance process, types of surveillance, and attributes of a surveillance system.

tags.name: Outbreak Scenario Analysis
tags.description: Analyze actual or hypothetical outbreaks given in case scenarios.

tags.name: Study Design
tags.description: Experimental vs. observational studies; case-control, cohort, ecological, cross-sectional, etc.; advantages, disadvantages and choosing a design.

tags.name: Steps of an Outbreak Investigation
tags.description: Steps in an outbreak investigation and how they guide hypothesis generation.

tags.name: Case Definition (Person, Place, Time)
tags.description: Using the person, place, and time triad to formulate case definitions; case classification.

tags.name: Epi Curves, Line Lists & Lab Data
tags.description: Interpret epi curves, line listings, cluster/spot maps, subdivided tables, PFGE gels, SNP mapping and PulseNet.

tags.name: Epidemiologic Triad & Chain of Transmission
tags.description: Agent-host-environment triad, chain of infection, reservoirs, portals, modes of transmission.

tags.name: Attack Rate, Relative Risk & Odds Ratio
tags.description: Calculate and compare attack rates, relative risk, odds ratios; judge whether data support a hypothesis.

tags.name: Causation Models
tags.description: Bradford Hill criteria, Koch's and Evans' postulates, DAGs, sufficient-component cause models, GRADE.

tags.name: Bias, Error & Confounding
tags.description: State/Nationals only: study design biases, random/systematic error, confounding, effect modification.

tags.name: Herd Immunity & Vaccine Effectiveness
tags.description: State/Nationals only: herd immunity, vaccine efficacy and effectiveness calculations.

tags.name: Patterns & Trends in Data
tags.description: Identify patterns and trends of epidemiologic data in charts, tables and graphs.

tags.name: Rates, Ratios & Proportions
tags.description: Calculate risk, ratio, proportion, incidence proportion (attack rate), incidence rate, prevalence, death rate and mortality rate.

tags.name: Disease Control Strategies
tags.description: Strategies of disease control (isolation, quarantine, vaccination, control/elimination/eradication, food safety) applied to scenarios.

tags.name: Levels of Prevention
tags.description: Scope and levels of prevention: primordial, primary, secondary, tertiary, quaternary.
